task.description:
Run the API-07 test suite and produce a structured test report.

Commands to run:
1. zig build test — runs all unit tests including test_api07_validation

Report format per test developer guide §8: Write results to tests/reports/API-07-test-report.md

Verify that all 36 API-07 validation tests pass (or identify failures with severity).
acceptance_criteria: Structured test report written to tests/reports/API-07-test-report.md
Report includes pass/fail/skip counts and issue details

result.summary: All 36 API-07 test assertions pass, but 8 memory leaks in src/api/validation.zig:validate() cause zig build test to exit with code 1. Leaking tests: TC-API-07-06 (2 leaks), TC-API-07-07 (4 leaks), TC-API-07-07b (2 leaks). Root cause: parseFromValue with .alloc_always creates an internal arena that is never freed.

issues.error_message: validate() leaks 2 allocations: internal ArenaAllocator from parseFromValue not freed when returning .ok
validate() leaks 4 allocations: internal ArenaAllocator from parseFromValue not freed when returning .errors, plus serialiseValidationErrors allocations in enforceValidation
enforceValidation() leaks 2 allocations: same root cause — internal ArenaAllocator from parseFromValue not freed when returning .ok

result.next_action: Route to ISSUE-FIXER (WF-03) to fix memory leaks in src/api/validation.zig:validate()
